added_lines: . svp church gate collection next week-end 31st october & 1st november. october choirs’ concert : raised €7130.00. a special thank you to all the choirs who participated. we thank friend pj coogan (96fm) who acted as mc on the night. we thank monsignor gearóid dullea and the parish council for allowing us to have our concert in our lady of lourdes’ church, ballinlough and to ruth and helen for organising it. unfolding the word: what mark’s gospel says about discipleship. an invitation to our family of parishes why not join us on thursdays 5th 12th 19th and 26th november in the parish room in holy cross church, mahon from 7.30 p.m. to 9.00 p.m. an opportunity to come together and spend some time reading and discussing the scriptures, followed by prayer. everyone is most welcome and we even have a cuppa and chat afterwards as well! ‘real generosity is doing something nice for someone who will never find out .’ how do you describe a generous person? one explanation is someone who is warm-hearted and who delights in ensuring the happiness and welfare of others. in irish there is one single word that sums it all up and it’s to be flaithiúlacht. there are many examples where god is generous or flaithiúlacht. in the wedding of cana, jesus asks that the jars be filled with water but goes a step further by saying, ‘fill them to the brim .’ in another story a vast number of fish are caught by disciples who had given up on catching any. the fish are so many that the nets begin to tear, and extra boats are called to help. god is lavish, generous and flaithiúlacht. when we think we least deserve god’s generosity is the moment when god is most generous. ballinlough
